meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文字、数据或标志做成几秒的动态视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让标题、数据或品牌标志动起来,做成一段短视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn text, data, or a logo into a short animated video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to animate headlines, stats, or a brand mark into a short clip

howto.what: Claude 会把你的需求做成一段短的动态图形(通常不到 10 秒、无旁白、无真人出镜),渲染成 MP4 或透明叠加层,涵盖动态文字、数字滚动、图表、logo 露出、字幕条、地图动画等类型。
howto.when: 当你要做一段不到 10 秒、无旁白的动态图形(如动态文字、图表动画、logo 露出等)时触发;更长、带旁白或多场景的需求会转到 /general-video,拿不准则先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这句话做成动态文字:设计是把复杂变简单
把 87% 这个数字做成滚动计数动画
用我的 logo 做一个品牌露出的结尾

howto.what_en: Claude turns your request into a short, design-led motion graphic (usually under 10s, no narration), rendered to MP4 or a transparent overlay — kinetic type, stat count-up, charts, logo stings, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a short, unnarrated motion graphic (e.g. kinetic type, a chart hit, a logo sting). Longer, narrated, or multi-scene requests go to /general-video; unsure → /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this line into kinetic typography: design makes complex things simple
